description: This file provides utility functions for managing API URLs, query strings, and headers within a JavaScript project, likely a frontend application using React. It includes functions for building query strings, resolving the API base URL with environment and window context considerations, adding tenant headers, and safely joining URLs related to API endpoints.

methods.name: buildQueryString(params = {})
methods.description: Constructs a URL query string from an object of parameters, filtering out undefined, null, or empty string values.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL based on environment variables, window location, or defaults to relative '/api'.

methods.name: withTenantHeaders(organizationId)
methods.description: Creates a headers object containing 'x-organization-id' if an organization ID is provided.

methods.name: joinApiPath(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path while ensuring that '/api' appears exactly once in the combined URL, handling absolute URLs, relative paths, and paths starting with '/api'.
